targets.rawSql:
WITH '$trace_id' AS tid,
     (SELECT min(Start) FROM otel.otel_traces_trace_id_ts WHERE TraceId = tid) AS t0,
     (SELECT max(End) + 1 FROM otel.otel_traces_trace_id_ts WHERE TraceId = tid) AS t1
SELECT TraceId AS traceID, SpanId AS spanID, ParentSpanId AS parentSpanID,
       ServiceName AS serviceName, SpanName AS operationName,
       multiply(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(Timestamp), 0.000001) AS startTime,
       multiply(Duration, 0.000001) AS duration,
       arrayMap(k -> map('key', k, 'value', SpanAttributes[k]), mapKeys(SpanAttributes)) AS tags,
       arrayMap(k -> map('key', k, 'value', ResourceAttributes[k]), mapKeys(ResourceAttributes)) AS serviceTags
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE TraceId = tid AND Timestamp >= t0 AND Timestamp <= t1
ORDER BY startTime

WITH '$trace_id' AS tid,
     (SELECT min(Start) FROM otel.otel_traces_trace_id_ts WHERE TraceId = tid) AS t0,
     (SELECT max(End) + 1 FROM otel.otel_traces_trace_id_ts WHERE TraceId = tid) AS t1,
     spans AS (SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, SpanAttributes['backend.pid'] AS pid, SpanAttributes['query.query_id'] AS qid
               FROM otel.otel_traces
               WHERE TraceId = tid AND Timestamp >= t0 AND Timestamp <= t1 AND ServiceName = 'PostgreSQL_Server')
SELECT Timestamp AS time, SeverityText AS level, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod,
       toFloat64OrNull(extract(JSONExtractString(Body, 'message'), 'duration: ([0-9.]+) ms')) AS ms,
       LogAttributes['query_id'] AS query_id,
       substring(replaceRegexpOne(JSONExtractString(Body, 'message'), '/\\*traceparent=.*?\\*/ ', ''), 1, 200) AS message
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'postgres-server-log' AND Timestamp >= t0 - INTERVAL 1 SECOND AND Timestamp <= t1 + INTERVAL 1 SECOND
  AND (position(Body, tid) > 0
       OR (ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'], JSONExtractString(Body, 'process_id'), LogAttributes['query_id'])
          IN (SELECT pod, pid, qid FROM spans WHERE qid NOT IN ('', '0')))
ORDER BY time

targets.rawSql:
WITH '$trace_id' AS tid,
     (SELECT min(Start) FROM otel.otel_traces_trace_id_ts WHERE TraceId = tid) AS t0,
     (SELECT max(End) + 1 FROM otel.otel_traces_trace_id_ts WHERE TraceId = tid) AS t1,
     (SELECT any(ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']) FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE TraceId = tid AND Timestamp >= t0 AND Timestamp <= t1
        AND ServiceName = 'PostgreSQL_Server') AS p
SELECT time, greatest(v - lagInFrame(v, 1, v) OVER (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) / 60 AS cpu_cores
FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time, max(Value) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
      WHERE MetricName = 'container_cpu_usage_seconds_total' AND Attributes['pod'] = p AND Attributes['container'] = 'postgres'
        AND TimeUnix BETWEEN t0 - INTERVAL 120 SECOND AND t1 + INTERVAL 120 SECOND
      GROUP BY time)
ORDER BY time

WITH '$trace_id' AS tid,
     (SELECT min(Start) FROM otel.otel_traces_trace_id_ts WHERE TraceId = tid) AS t0,
     (SELECT max(End) + 1 FROM otel.otel_traces_trace_id_ts WHERE TraceId = tid) AS t1,
     (SELECT any(ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']) FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE TraceId = tid AND Timestamp >= t0 AND Timestamp <= t1
        AND ServiceName = 'PostgreSQL_Server') AS p
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 15 SECOND) AS time,
       sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['shared_blks_read'])) / 15 AS disk_blocks_per_sec
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'pg_stat_ch' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] = p
  AND Timestamp BETWEEN t0 - INTERVAL 120 SECOND AND t1 + INTERVAL 120 SECOND
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
